description: OPEN. CONFIGURABLE. Lightweight persistent markdown memory for OPENCODE sessions - inspired by Claude Code's auto-memory. Fully local and plug-in native. Primarily for personal use, but feel free to join in the fun.

detail.description_zh: 开放的。可配置的。通过 MEMORY.md 注入为 opencode 会话提供全球持久内存（就像我们的母体 Claude Code 一样）。
